name: movie-2a-playing-window
description: #81 (M2 exit, mode-detection set): movie, mid-way. From movie-playing (about 10 s into the opening, movie-2-playing), mark, then 60 frames with no input (MOVIE_SPAN_FRAMES). Checks: Stframe_no increased since the mark (advancing), g_GameState reads field 1 (mode_ok). Together mode() reports movie. match: a rerun.

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16, read as u16): field 1, battle 2, world 3, menu 5, minigame 6 (confirmed #76, #80). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 config/symbols.main.us.txt (reference only, no code)

prev_state.description: g_PrevGameState (s16, read as u16): the mode before (confirmed #76, #107). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 config/symbols.main.us.txt (reference only, no code)

movie_frame.description: Stframe_no, the streaming library's movie frame number: advances while a movie plays, holds its last value after (confirmed #76). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 config/symbols.main.us.txt (reference only, no code)
